aiOverview.content: Philadelphia is the epicenter of America's 250th anniversary (Semiquincentennial) in 2026, hosting major international sports and historical celebrations. Key events include FIFA World Cup 26 matches (including July 4th), the MLB All-Star Game, PGA Championship, NCAA March Madness, and the massive Wawa Welcome America July 4th festival. Major 2026 Philadelphia Events FIFA World Cup 26 (June-July): Lincoln Financial Field ("Philadelphia Stadium") hosts six matches, including a round-of-16 game on July 4, 2026. America’s 250th Birthday (July 4, 2026): The nation's main celebration featuring Wawa Welcome America events and the Red, White, & Blue To-Do. MLB All-Star Game 2026 (July): Held at Citizens Bank Park, along with the MLB All-Star Village. PGA Championship (May): Played at Aronimink Golf Club. NCAA Men’s March Madness: Early rounds hosted in Philadelphia. 52 Weeks of Firsts: A year-long series of events highlighting Philly's history as a "first" in many areas. TED Democracy Philadelphia: A flagship event at Marian Anderson Hall featuring talks on the future of democracy. Museum & Cultural Exhibits: The National Constitution Center is opening new galleries, and the Museum of the American Revolution will feature "The Declaration's Journey". Major Concerts: Including K-pop group (G)I-DLE at Xfinity Mobile Arena (August 6, 2026). Upcoming Anniversaries & Festivals RockyFest 50: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of Rocky. Philadelphia Juneteenth Parade & Festival: Major celebration on June 21, 2026. 50th Anniversary of the Mann Center: Special anniversary performance in July. For a full schedule and to plan trips, check the Visit Philadelphia 2026 Guide. Visit Philadelphia 2026 Guide
